title: Add required PR Playwright navigation-freeze gate
description:
Problem: navigation lockups can regress without detection because the PR CI workflow does not execute browser route-hop tests.

Desired outcome: make a deterministic Playwright navigation-freeze regression test a required pull-request quality gate.

Scope:
- In scope: wire Playwright setup and execution into CI for PR/push, enforce failure on regression, and publish diagnostic artifacts for browser failures.
- Out of scope: broad end-to-end suite expansion beyond deterministic navigation-freeze coverage.

Dependencies:
- e2e Playwright test harness (`e2e/tests/navigation-freeze.spec.ts`).
- CI workflow updates under `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.

Acceptance criteria:
- CI runs navigation-freeze Playwright test on PRs and fails when it fails.
- Browser artifacts (trace/screenshot/video where available) are uploaded for failed runs.
- Required check naming is stable for branch protection.

Validation:
- Trigger workflow with known-good baseline and confirm pass.
- Trigger induced failure and verify artifact upload plus failing status.

Rollback:
- Feature-flag or temporarily mark browser gate non-blocking while retaining artifact output for diagnosis.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from audit finding F-001/F-002 to close CI gap for browser navigation-freeze regressions.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Completed by adding the browser-navigation-freeze CI job that installs Playwright Chromium, runs npm run test:nav-freeze, and uploads e2e/playwright-report plus e2e/test-results on failure. The local navigation-freeze suite initially exposed a stale navigation locator; after fixing the helper, npm run test:nav-freeze passed 3/3 tests locally. Remote GitHub Actions execution was not triggered in this local session.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: 2026-08-08 deep-dive found the navigation-freeze Playwright describe block is currently skipped while CI still invokes it. Historical completion evidence is contradicted by the live test file; new TSK-0470 tracks re-enablement and a nonzero executed-test assertion.
